seed: Every drag off the shelf lands a COPY and nothing else: since 2026-10-04 the original goes into the document's component library, not beside the drop (the user: 'how does always a copy translate into copy AND original'). This walk drops one, reads the copy's short panel, opens the original through Edit Original and comes back, then drops a second copy.

steps.comment: The Badge rather than the first tile: since 2026-10-09 the Button is nine looks with a Variant and Size panel, too tall for the shelf to come back under it in this window.

The panel is looking at what the drop PRODUCED. The shelf asks to come back after a fetch, and it is only allowed as far as the new component's own section can afford, so the section named after the thing you just put down is whole on screen without you scrolling to it (filed 2026-09-22: the shelf reveal used to carry it from 169 to -101 in a dock 841 tall).
...and the shelf has not been abandoned for it: its header is at the bottom edge, so a second drop is one flick rather than a hunt.

steps.note: the drag lands ONE copy, picked, and its panel is the short one: which look it shows and a value per property, with no Name field, no sharing switch and no Add

steps.comment: The Background plus ONE Badge of two pieces. Before 2026-10-04 the first drop also stood the original beside it: 7.

steps.note: Edit Original opens the original in its own space, with its long panel, and the title bar says which component it is with Done

steps.comment: The Badge rather than the first tile: since 2026-10-09 the Button is nine looks with a Variant and Size panel, too tall for the shelf to come back under it in this window.

steps.note: a second drag reads exactly the same as the first: another copy, and still no original on the canvas
